en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large military barracks building with corner towers and a central spire behind a line of trees. In the large open parade ground in the foreground, several formations of soldiers and horse-drawn artillery are assembled in review. At the top in red German text it identifies the scene as a barracks in Dresden for a Saxon rifle (fusilier) regiment.
